{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_parsed'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify completed orders
completed_only = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Identify QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue_parsed'] == 999999.99]

# Remove QA orders from completed orders
completed_cleaned = completed_only[completed_only['revenue_parsed'] != 999999.99]

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = completed_cleaned['revenue_parsed'].mean()

# Now print ONLY the values that will appear in evidence
print(len(completed_only))
print(len(qa_orders))
print(len(completed_cleaned))
print(mean_revenue)"}
